overview_description.description: Drawdeck was founded by two creative enthusiasts for one reason, to make affordable art accessible to the Middle East! Everyday artists around the world go unnoticed and the Drawdeck platform aims at enabling emerging talent to share their work to a wider audience. Drawdeck carefully curate the artists we represent to offer the best in quality & variety! Each sale directly supports the artist behind the design, meaning your purchase helps these artists…be artists!
